scope: Three peer-reviewed Philippines herpetofauna study accounts
policy: Site-specific evidence only. No new taxonomy, inferred current presence, disease, global conservation status or location-specific survey detection.

records.label: Day-active and nocturnal shelter observations
records.text: During northeast Mindanao surveys, Philippine sailfin lizards were seen active in daylight and found resting in rock crevices at night along rivers at sampled sites between 170 and 420 m elevation.
records.sourceLocation: Species account Hydrosaurus pustulatus, local survey observations
records.studyScope: Documented northeast Mindanao river sites and sampled individuals only. Not a universal activity schedule, national elevation limit or claim of present occurrence at any user station.

records.label: Northern Sierra Madre disturbed-site encounters
records.text: The 2013 northern Luzon survey reported marbled water monitors in coastal and agricultural areas, scrub vegetation, secondary growth, primary forest patches and forest edges at low to mid elevations.
records.sourceLocation: Family Varanidae: Varanus marmoratus, species account
records.studyScope: Field encounters and synthesis from Cagayan and Isabela, northern Luzon, not an occupancy model or evidence that every Philippine island has the species.

records.label: Caramoan coastal and mangrove record
records.text: Researchers documented a water monitor assigned to V. dalubhasa near mangrove vegetation in the Caramoan Island Group and described coastal plains and river margins among reported habitat contexts.
records.source: Clores et al. (2021), Journal of Asia-Pacific Biodiversity 14:1–14
records.sourceLocation: Varanidae: Varanus dalubhasa, Figure 16 and Caramoan study account
records.studyScope: Caramoan Island Group survey context with one collected individual at a coastal mangrove-adjacent locality. Broad habitat descriptions reference related earlier work, not quantified habitat preference.

records.label: Caramoan survey specimen
records.text: The Caramoan Island Group survey documented a specimen assigned to Varanus dalubhasa near Sitio Bogtong on Lahuy Island.
records.source: Clores et al. (2021), Journal of Asia-Pacific Biodiversity 14:1–14
records.sourceLocation: Varanidae: Varanus dalubhasa, Lahuy Island account
records.studyScope: A published 2021 Caramoan specimen record, not proof of current occurrence elsewhere or a generalized geographic range.
